items.t: Tributes pour in following 'Star Trek' actor Patrick Stewart's death
items.x: Tributes are pouring in online for beloved actor Patrick Stewart, who died Wednesday at the age of 86.

items.t: 10 Tampa Bay Weather: Breezy conditions continue ahead of Sunday showers
items.x: Halloween looks mainly dry and warm across Tampa Bay before a front brings a better chance of showers on Sunday.

items.t: Attorneys discuss saw, blood testing in McKay Bay dismemberment murder trial
items.x: The murder trial of Robert Kessler continued Friday. Kessler is accused of killing and dismembering a woman in 2021.

items.t: Epstein bookmobile makes stops in Tampa Bay ahead of midterms
items.x: A traveling exhibit filled with 3.5 million redacted Jeffrey Epstein files from the Department of Justice was in Tampa Bay on Thursday. Outside the truck, there’s a picture of President Trump alongside a picture of the disgraced financier.

items.t: St. Pete businesses reflect on Rays' World Series run
items.x: Local bars and restaurants are reflecting on the boost in business as the Rays prepare for their next chapter in Tampa.

items.t: Florida mom fights wrongful death law after daughter dies hours after leaving hospital
items.x: Two years after her only daughter died just hours after leaving a Florida hospital, Beth Miller says she is still searching for answers. She also wants to make sure another family does not face the same barriers she has encountered.

items.t: Head of California high-speed rail agency resigns amid travel expenses scandal
items.x: The CEO of California's high-speed rail authority has resigned after a two-year tenure marked by budget woes, delays and spending scandals. Here's what happened.

items.t: Pasco leaders experience challenges of living in poverty through simulation
items.x: New Port Richey simulation puts community stakeholders in the roles of struggling families to help them better understand barriers to basic needs

items.t: 'We're not out for vengeance": church speaks out after contractor accused of stealing $736K appears in court
items.x: A contractor is accused of stealing almost $1 million from a church. Clearwater police said the suspect was spending the church's money buying cars and vacations.

items.t: Lakeland’s South Florida Avenue redesign could take 3.5 years
items.x: Drivers have navigated concrete barriers along South Florida Avenue in Lakeland for six years. Now, the city has a new timeline for making the controversial road diet permanent.

items.t: VIDEO: Deer smashes into customer, crashes through window at laundromat
items.x: Chaos erupted at a North Carolina laundromat on Tuesday after a deer crashed through the window and ran amok inside the business.

items.t: Florida Education Department reports data breach impacting 4.9M people
items.x: The Florida Department of Education is investigating a data breach affecting 4.9 million people via its financial aid site.

items.t: Former handler donates K9 Vader after Polk County shooting forces Ace to retire
items.x: A Polk County deputy is back with a new four-legged recruit just months after her K9 partner, Ace, was shot and forced into retirement following a line of duty shooting in early August.

items.t: 'He told me he has to turn himself in': 12-year-old testifies in Robert Kessler murder trial
items.x: The girl, who considered Kessler her father, described hearing an argument, noticing a strange smell inside their home and watching him clean out victim's bedroom.

items.t: St. Pete residents voice hope about Historic Gas Plant development
items.x: With only two seasons left of baseball at Tropicana Field, people who live in St. Pete said planning for development of the Historic Gas Plant District needs to really begin.

items.t: Tampa Dream Gala raises money for Type 1 diabetes research as community rallies behind a cure
items.x: Breakthrough T1D hosts its Tampa Dream Gala Nov. 7, raising money for Type 1 diabetes research and the search for a cure.

items.t: A historic drop for Alphabet's stock drags the US market lower
items.x: Google and YouTube's parent company was the main reason for stock market losses on Thursday.

items.t: HHS eases restrictions on certain unapproved peptides
items.x: Health and Human Services is moving forward with a policy for the use of compound specific unapproved peptides while regulators assess their safety and effectiveness.

items.t: Florida man threatens to shoot deputies, bites K-9 while hiding in palm fronds, sheriff's office says
items.x: A Florida man threatened to shoot deputies and bit a K-9 while hiding in palm fronds at Canaveral National Seashore on Wednesday, according to the Volusia County Sheriff's Office.

items.t: Clearwater construction fraud: Contractor accused of taking $832K from church
items.x: Clearwater police arrested contractor William Botelho, the owner of Custom Building Solutions, on Wednesday and charged him with grand theft over $100,000.
